title: Emergency Sub-Account Position Force-Close Without Disconnecting LPOA
precondition: Single sub-account requires immediate derisking by risk manager.
steps: 1. Risk Officer clicks 'Force Close Sub-Account Positions'.
expected_result: Child positions closed at market; LPOA remains bound for future trading; manager alerted.
actual_result: Risk officer force-closes sub-account child positions at market while keeping LPOA bound for future strategy trades.
